roles.label: Removal
roles.description: Deals with one opposing creature or threat: destroy, exile, burn, pacify, bounce.

roles.label: Card advantage
roles.description: Draws extra cards or keeps the hand full over time.

roles.label: Cheap interaction
roles.description: Instants and cheap spells that swing combat or answer a play for two mana or less.

roles.label: Finisher
roles.description: A threat that ends the game on its own: a big body, a big flyer, or a planeswalker.

roles.label: Ramp
roles.description: Mana creatures, mana rocks, and spells that fetch lands, costing three or less.

roles.label: Early creature
roles.description: A creature costing one or two, so the deck has plays on the first turns.

roles.label: Evasive threat
roles.description: A creature that gets past blockers: flying, menace, and similar.
